experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Openly downloadable dataset, small enough to fit in memory.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether adding interaction terms to a linear model reduces prediction error on housing prices.
experiment_plans.design: Comparative benchmark of two regression specifications on one train/test split.

data_requirements.description: A public tabular regression dataset of housing prices with numeric predictors, downloadable over HTTP.

methods.name: linear regression
methods.description: Ordinary least squares fitted by gradient descent.

methods.name: polynomial interaction expansion
methods.description: Add all pairwise products of numeric predictors before fitting.

evaluation.baseline: Linear regression on the raw predictors.
evaluation.success_criteria: The interaction model reduces test RMSE by at least 5% relative to the baseline.

risks: Interaction expansion may overfit on a small sample.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
